stem:
The oak mistletoe is a green, leafy plant that grows on trees and has white berries. Mistletoe seeds are spread to other trees through the waste of birds that feed on the berries. The mistletoe seedlings grow into the tree to obtain water and nutrients.

Which answer choice correctly identifies a relationship between two of these organisms?

options.label: A
options.text: The relationship between the tree and the mistletoe is commensalism.

options.label: B
options.text: The relationship between the birds and the trees is predator-prey.

options.label: C
options.text: The relationship between the birds and the trees is mutualism.

options.label: D
options.text: The relationship between the tree and the mistletoe is parasitism.
